connectorUiConfig.title: Prancer Data Connector
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Prancer Data Connector provides the capability to ingest [Prancer CSPM](https://docs.prancer.io/web/CSPM/) and [PAC](https://docs.prancer.io/web/PAC/introduction/) findings into Microsoft Sentinel using Microsoft Sentinel's Codeless Connector Platform (CCP). This solution deploys the Data Collection Endpoint (DCE), Data Collection Rule (DCR), and the `PrancerFindings_CL` custom table. Prancer's backend then pushes findings directly into your workspace using the [Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview) against the deployed DCR. Refer to the [Prancer Documentation](https://docs.prancer.io/web) for more information.

customs.name: Monitoring Metrics Publisher
customs.description: Prancer's ingestion identity (the Microsoft Entra ID application registration created for your tenant during onboarding) must be assigned the **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** role, scoped to the Data Collection Rule (DCR) deployed by this solution. This grants least-privilege permission to push findings via the Logs Ingestion API and nothing more.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create ARM resources and provide the required permissions
instructionSteps.description: This connector lets Prancer PenSuiteAI push scan findings directly to Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API.

parameters.content:
#### Automated configuration and secure ingestion with an Entra application
Clicking **Deploy** creates the `PrancerFindings_CL` Log Analytics table and a Data Collection Rule (DCR), then creates an Entra application, links the DCR to it and assigns the **Monitoring Metrics Publisher** role scoped to that DCR. This is the least-privilege role required to push findings, and it lets Prancer send data securely using an Entra token.

#### One connector per workspace

The DCR and the `PrancerFindings_CL` table are named from this workspace, so deploying the connector again in the same Log Analytics workspace reuses them rather than creating a second set.

Findings from more than one Prancer tenant can be sent to the same connector; they share the table and are distinguished by `CustomerId` and `CompanyName`. To keep tenants in separate tables, with their own retention or access control, use a separate Log Analytics workspace for each.
